legacyHome.authLead: This project is under construction and grows with the community. Here you will find the project status and how to take part.
legacyHome.authHeading: A project under construction, built together
legacyHome.authBody: Academia Blockchain moves forward because the community takes part. The features you see today will grow over time; your use, feedback, and contributions are part of that process.
legacyHome.authContribute: If you are a programmer, you can contribute directly to the code: the project is open source. In the <github>GitHub repository</github> you will find the roadmap, issues, and the docs for joining the development.
legacyHome.paymentsBody: We will enable cryptocurrency payments for courses, events, and knowledge paths. That will make a deeper act of resistance possible: exchange outside the fiat economy. This feature still depends on regulation, and in my country using crypto as a means of payment is prohibited. We are considering a company in El Salvador or Paraguay — if you know this terrain, please contact us.
legacyHome.blockchainBody: We have not implemented blockchain for payments because of regulation, but the chain is a technology that goes beyond money: the next step is to use it to store NFTs, content, and education certificates. That will matter in a world where false news threatens to rewrite the past. A hash in a Bitcoin block assures us that "this document" existed at that moment in time.
legacyHome.filesBody: Have you noticed that the most important web platforms do everything they can to keep you from the file itself? On Academia Blockchain, whenever possible, educational content, documents, and resources can be downloaded and stored in a decentralized way. We will integrate technologies such as IPFS and other solutions such as Filecoin. Together we can make sure a file is never erased.
legacyHome.connectionsBody: The platform connects topics, knowledge paths, and people. Have you noticed that when you scroll a social network, every piece of content sits at the same level? Everything matters the same: there is no path. The scroll keeps the shallowness of a slot machine. The "search box," on the other hand, does its best to hand you one authoritative answer and hide the rest. Research on Academia Blockchain is open source.
legacyHome.notABusiness: Academia Blockchain is not a business
legacyHome.support: Servers cost money and programmers need to eat. Academia Blockchain has to cover its costs. We also know that taking certain investors who want a clear financial return would lock us into building the most profitable "business model" possible. That is a poor lens if we want to see decentralization. There are different ways to <github>support the project.</github>
legacyHome.heroLead: Learn from autonomy. Explore topics created by the community and build your own learning network.
legacyHome.what1: Academia Blockchain is more than a platform: it is an intellectual territory where knowledge is a common good, not a resource captured by institutions, algorithms, or economic interests. We are not a trading academy or a cryptocurrency. We are a place where the community links knowledge, reorganizes it, and sets it free, in the spirit of the early internet.
legacyHome.what2: We exist because of an uncomfortable fact: the architecture of modern knowledge is at the mercy of censorship, manipulation, and concentrated power. The search engine and the AI that should open doors actually decide what to show; the university, which should illuminate, has become an elitist club; scientific journals, which should guard the truth, often bend to political or economic interests. In that noise, what matters is lost: the ability to learn without intermediaries, to explore without permission, to know without filters.
legacyHome.what3: On Academia Blockchain, ideas connect to each other collaboratively through knowledge paths created by the community and through topics. Content can be related, downloaded, organized, and preserved with technologies such as IPFS and blockchain, which we will roll out gradually as development advances. They will guarantee permanence, resistance to censorship, and an open educational ecosystem.
legacyHome.studentsBody: You want freedom in how you learn, without rigid structures.
legacyHome.researchersBody: You want to expand what you know and you value learning on your own.
legacyHome.educatorsBody: You want to share knowledge and contribute to a research community.
legacyHome.communityBody: Open conversation and decentralized archives protect us from censorship.
legacyHome.discoverTitle: Discover topics created by the community
legacyHome.discoverBody: Explore content organized by topics of interest, where each topic is moderated and enriched by the community.
legacyHome.pathsBody: Knowledge paths guide you step by step through a sequence of content designed to build understanding over time.
